note: Artwork manifest for The Vault, ROADMAP T2.1 and T3.3. One entry per delivered file. Nothing is invented in here: an empty items array is the truth, and the wall prints its own empty state for that section. Club Graphs is not in here, it reads data/graphs.json instead.

itemShape.file: filename inside dir. png, jpg, webp or svg. An svg is inlined so the wall's fonts apply, with an img tag as the fallback.
itemShape.title: what the card is called. Falls back to the filename when missing.
itemShape.note: optional one line under the title. Leave it out rather than padding it.
itemShape.layout: optional on a section. "pages" renders the items as a continuous page flow with no per item chrome, for a document that was split into images. Anything else renders one titled card per item.
itemShape.document: optional on a section. The original file the images came from, offered as a download above the pages.
itemShape.links: optional on a section. External links, each { url, label, note }. A section may hold only links and no files, which is how an off site booklet lives in the vault without anything being copied into the repo.
itemShape.caption: optional on a section. Paragraphs printed above the links and cards. The client's own wording, reproduced as sent.
